b1.ryoka_runs_the_high_passes.rumor: They say a Runner came out of the High Passes alive this week, the first in years, after Carn Wolves, Gargoyles and worse.

canon_ref.note: Same day as 1.39R; a few hours' run. Theofore's team of [Assassins] was hired by Magnolia to guard her and lost her.

b1.ryoka_runs_the_high_passes.summary: Near the passes Ryoka fights off a Goblin band and kills one with a kick by mistake. A Carn Wolf savages her arm, and her 'healing' potions are mana. Killer goats, Gargoyles and Razorbeaks chase her bleeding into a vast cave hoard, where an old mage wakes. She hands him the request and faints.
